notes.subject: וגזית נבנה
notes.rationale: Hebrew has two verbs (cut-stone we-will-build); Bambara folds 'build' into the ni…ye construction and 'renew' into yɛlɛma

notes.subject: an
notes.rationale: Hebrew omits the pronoun 'we'; supplied to carry the boast

notes.subject: quotation
notes.rationale: The verse is Israel's arrogant boast quoted — speech addressed by the people about themselves, not to the reader

translation: Lɛbɛnw bɔyara, nka an bɛna bɔ ni kabakurun tiɲɛnenw ye; sikamɔrɛ jiriw bɛtigiyara, nka an bɛna bɔ yɛlɛma araz jiriw la.

tokens.gloss: nka an bɛna bɔ ni kabakurun tiɲɛnenw ye
